description: Files: standalone extension installation test. Tests first: fresh creation, pre-migration repeat/password rotation, unexpected owner and migration ledger rejection without credential mutation, role safety, all-schema current/future table reader SELECT and denied writes/DDL, extension ownership and runtime recreation. Real PostgreSQL/ParadeDB; no mocks. SQL coverage via scenario matrix rather than BEAM coverage.
